newsitem.title: UK: BOE allots total 950 mln stg in UK money mkt help.
newsitem.headline: BOE allots total 950 mln stg in UK money mkt help.

text.p: The Bank of England said that it provided a total of 950 million stg in liquidity to the UK money market on Wednesday, comprising 6.25 percent repos to June 10 and 11 and outright offers of bills to June 11.
The central bank initialy forecast a liquidity shortage of 1.1 billion stg but later revised this to 950 million.
No use was made of the discount house late repo facility
